data.name: Isteyak
data.gender_notes: Isteyak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Isteyak is a name of Hindu origin, derived from the Sanskrit word 'istikaya' meaning 'sacrifice, offering'. This name reflects the spiritual significance of selflessness, generosity, and devotion. The name Isteyak carries the meaning “Sacrifice, Offering” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Isteyak usually hope their child will grow to embody sacrifice, offering and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Isteyak represents the divine act of offering and surrendering to the higher power, symbolizing the ultimate act of selflessness and devotion. It is also associated with the element of fire, representing transformation and purification.
data.etymology: Isteyak belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sacrifice, Offering.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isteyak total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
